'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Joe Giannetti LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Sigga
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
